OpenAI、数日内に「GPT-6 Cyber」発表か サイバーセキュリティ特化型モデルでAI防御を強化
evidence.body: [e003:f01] 《Fortune》が複数の関係者の話として報じたところによると、GPT-6 Cyberは早ければ9月29日にOpenAIがサンフランシスコで開催するイベントで発表される可能性があり、同社のセキュリティプログラムに参加する一部の顧客はすでにアルファテスト権限を取得している。 [e003:f02] 前日、OpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOと競合Anthropicのダリオ・アモデイCEOが異例の共同登壇で国連安全保障理事会に臨み、先進AIがもたらし得る壊滅的リスクを防ぐため、各国に対しグローバルなAI安全調整メカニズムの構築と開発ペースの減速を呼びかけたばかりだった。 [e003:f03] 今年7月にOpenAIのモデルがHugging Faceに侵入した事件や、オーストラリア政府が明らかにしたAIエージェントによる医療データポータルへの不正アクセス事件は、AIセキュリティリスクの高まりを浮き彫りにしており、サイバーセキュリティはAI産業で最も成長が速い市場の一つとなっている。 [e003:f04] OpenAIは同時に、顧客がこの新モデルをより安全かつ自動化された方法で展開・運用できるようにする付随製品の準備も進めている。 [e003:f05] アモデイ氏はさらに、国連安保理が生物兵器の製造を含む特定の高リスクなAI利用を禁止する限定的な合意を検討すべきだと主張した。 [e003:f06] 今年7月、OpenAIの複数のモデルが内部評価中に隔離テスト環境を突破し、AIオープンソースプラットフォーム「Hugging Face」のシステムに侵入した。 [e003:f07] これはAIエージェントが人間の指示なしに独自にセキュリティサンドボックスを突破し、サイバー攻撃を実行した初の記録的事例となった。 [e003:f08] 事態を受けてOpenAIは一部モデルの研究開発と訓練作業を自主的に一時停止し、業界の研究者や企業幹部に衝撃が走った。 [e003:f09] 同様に、オーストラリアのアンソニー・アルバニージー首相は24日、OpenAIのAIエージェントが今年6月の評価演習中にオーストラリア政府の医療データポータルサイトに侵入していたと発表した。 [e003:f10] OpenAIは今年すでに複数のセキュリティ特化型モデルを投入しており、GPT-6 Cyberは4機種目となる。 [e003:f11] 安保理はグローバルな規制体制の構築ではなく、各国の能力強化に向けたベストプラクティスの共有に注力すべきだと主張した。 [e003:f12] ただし、米国がグローバルな規制枠組みに明確に反対する立場を取る中で、この公約がどこまで実現するかは注視が必要だ。 [e003:f13] OpenAIとAnthropicはいずれも大規模な新規株式公開（IPO）を行うとの見方が広がっており、Anthropicの評価額は最大2兆ドル（約317.2兆円）に達すると報じられている。 [e003:f14] AI開発の減速と安全対策の強化を訴えることと、商業的成長を追求し上場準備を進めることのバランスをどう取るのか、投資家にはまだ明確な答えが見えていない。 [e003:f15] テスラのイーロン・マスクCEOは先日、中国国営メディアのインタビューで、米中がAI規制プラットフォームについて合意できれば世界の安全にとって極めて重要だと述べた。 [e003:f16] GPT-6 Cyberの発表が目前に迫る中、OpenAIは一見矛盾する二つの路線を同時に推し進めている。

evidence.title: OpenAI・Anthropic・Google、自主規制機関「SAFA」を設立へ
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 仮称は「Standards Authority for Frontier AI(SAFA)」。 [e004:f02] 目次 Toggle ■担う機能は4つ 同メディアによると、SAFAの主な機能は4つある。 [e004:f03] 一つ目は、公開前のモデルをテストする第三者機関の支援。 [e004:f04] 現在この検査を担うのは米商務省傘下のCAISI(AI標準・イノベーションセンター)だが、協議メンバーの一部は、CAISIの予算や人員では最先端モデルを十分に検査できないと 懸念している という。 [e004:f05] 科学顧問の候補には、AIリスクを評価する米非営利団体METRの創業者でCEOのBeth Barnes氏と、CAISIの顧問でOpenAIの財団の理事に最近就任したPaul Christiano氏が挙がった。 [e004:f06] ■政府版は大統領令の草案まで進んで頓挫 構想の原点は、当時Google DeepMindのCEOを務めていたDemis Hassabis氏が7月に公表した提案だ。 [e004:f07] 手本は、米国の証券業界の自主規制機関FINRA(金融取引業規制機構)。 [e004:f08] Huang氏は「新しい法律も新しい規制も要らない」と 言い切っている 。 [e004:f09] そのうえでホワイトハウスは3社に、政府が関与する前に まず業界内で合意を取りつけるよう求めた 。 [e004:f10] OpenAIのAIエージェント群が安全テスト中に、AIモデル共有サイトを運営する米Hugging Faceのシステムに侵入した事件は、 規制を求める声を一段と強めた 。 [e004:f11] ■既存団体と重複、「見せかけ」の声も SAFAの役割は、CAISIや、ホワイトハウスがつくったモデル公開前テストの自主的な枠組みと重なる。 [e004:f12] 3社と米Microsoftが2023年に設立した業界団体Frontier Model Forumとも、目的の多くが共通する。 [e004:f13] 企業向けAIを開発する加Cohere CEOのAidan Gomez氏は9月13日、自社サイトで公開したエッセイで、大手による基準づくりを 「名を変えただけのカルテル」と批判した 。 [e004:f14] ■表では「政府が決めるべき」 3社が非公開で協議を重ねる一方、経営者たちは表舞台で政府の役割を強調してきた。 [e004:f15] OpenAI CEOのSam Altman氏は今週、国連安全保障理事会で演説し、AIをめぐる重要な決定はサンフランシスコのAI企業だけで下せるものではなく、国民に責任を負う政府が民主的な手続きを経て決めるべきだと 訴えた 。 [e004:f16] 主な出典 The Information:https:// Zuckerberg氏・Huang氏の発言:https:// Gomez氏の批判:https:// 、https:// 、https:// 関連する記事 AI競争は「2強から4強」＝Google次期モデルは開発遅れか 暴走するAI、ついに一般ユーザーの画像まで流出 OpenAIのAIエージェント、豪政府サイトに無断侵入 Google Gemini、評価中に実企業3社へ侵入。

evidence.title: Appleとの提携でChatGPT普及を狙ったOpenAI、期待外れだったことが裁判資料で判明
evidence.body: [e005:f01] しかし、OpenAI側はiPhoneユーザーの利用が「期待を大幅に下回った」と述べていたことが、新たな裁判所への提出書類から明らかになったと英Financial Timesが報じている。 [e005:f02] この裁判は2025年8月、イーロン・マスク氏のAI企業xAIが、アップルとOpenAIを相手取って起こした反トラスト法訴訟である。 [e005:f03] マスク氏は当初、アップルがOpenAI以外のAI企業をApp Storeのランキングで不当に扱っていると主張し、法的措置を取ると 述べていた 。 [e005:f04] これに対してアップルとOpenAIは、両社の提携は他社のAIモデルとの連携を排除するような排他的なものではないと主張している。 [e005:f05] そうした法廷でのやり取りの中で出てきたのが、今回OpenAIが新たに提出した書類である。 [e005:f06] FTの報道によると、OpenAIは「ChatGPTをApple Intelligenceで利用するために両社が2024年に契約を結んだ後、アップルを通じたiPhoneユーザーのChatGPT利用が期待したほど伸びなかったことに失望していた」と述べているという。 [e005:f07] OpenAIは当初、アップルの宣伝力やブランドとの結びつきによる「ハロー効果」により、ChatGPTの有料契約者が増えると見込んでいた。 [e005:f08] しかし、統合開始から約1カ月後には「出足が鈍い」と判断し、週次アクティブユーザー数の予測を引き下げていたとのこと。 [e005:f09] 2025年夏までには、アップルによるChatGPT統合が「著しく期待を下回っている」ことが明確になったとしている。 [e005:f10] また、提出書類の一部からは、OpenAIの幹部らが、アップルが別のAIパートナーの確保を急ぐのを懸念していたこともうかがえるという。 [e005:f11] 実際、アップルは2024年のApple Intelligence発表時から、ユーザーが複数のAIモデルを選べるようにしたいとの考えを示していた。 [e005:f12] その後、アップルはGoogleと提携し、同社のGeminiモデルを基盤として次世代のApple Foundation Modelsを開発。 [e005:f13] これが 新しいSiri AI を含むApple Intelligenceのベースとなった。 [e005:f14] アップルとOpenAIの関係をめぐっては、その後も対立につながる動きが起きている。 [e005:f15] アップルは2026年7月、OpenAIおよび元アップル従業員2人を相手取り、OpenAIの消費者向けハードウェア開発に関連して、アップルの営業秘密を不正に取得・利用したとして 提訴 した。 [e005:f16] 今回の一件では、マスク氏からアップルと密接に提携しているとみなされたOpenAIが、実際にはその提携から期待したほどの恩恵を受けていなかったことを明らかにするという、奇妙な構図が浮かび上がったことになる。

evidence.title: OpenAI’s “o” update: what the ChatGPT leak reveals
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Its capabilities, launch date, and commercial terms remain unconfirmed. [e001:f02] Prepared September 26, 2026 · Last checked September 26, 2026, 9:21 p.m. [e001:f03] PDT · Living report A line in a ChatGPT Pro upgrade screenshot offers a strikingly compact product pitch: “o, your always-on assistant.” Jake Boggs posted the image on September 25. [e001:f04] Together, the two artifacts suggest OpenAI is preparing an assistant with a recognizable identity and an ongoing role in a user’s work. [e001:f05] The launch story remains incomplete. [e001:f06] At this report’s cutoff, the official release notes, pricing page, and DevDay material checked for this article did not announce a product called “o.” The evidence supports reporting a possible upcoming assistant; it does not support promising readers a release date or a feature list. [e001:f07] ChatGPT release notes , official pricing , DevDay 2026 . [e001:f08] It will launch at DevDay on September 29. [e001:f09] The event is confirmed; an “o” announcement or same-day release is not. [e001:f10] “Aeon” is the model powering it. [e001:f11] That placement suggests a product experience people might recognize and use, although it cannot tell us whether the wording was a test, a placeholder, or finished launch copy. [e001:f12] The displayed price belongs to the plan. [e001:f13] September 29 is the date to watch OpenAI’s DevDay takes place on Tuesday, September 29, 2026, in San Francisco. [e001:f14] “Aeon” remains an unresolved part of the rumor Leo, posting as @synthwavedd, says “o” will be a DevDay launch powered by an Astra variant called “aeon,” designed for extended tasks. [e001:f15] Nor does the single-letter name establish a new reasoning-model generation, an upgrade to GPT-4o, or a return of the older o-series branding. [e001:f16] OpenAI’s June 17 release notes announced that Pulse would be sunset as proactive updates moved into scheduled tasks.

evidence.title: ソフトバンクG、過去最大のハイイールド債で111億ドル調達——OpenAI最終トランシェ資金に充当
evidence.body: [e002:f01] ソフトバンクグループは、OpenAIへの300億ドルの追加投資のうち最終となる100億ドルのトランシェに充当するため、ドル建て・ユーロ建て社債で111億ドルを調達した。 [e002:f02] 9月24日の東京市場で株価は一時7%上昇したが、終値は0.6%高にとどまった。 [e002:f03] 10月1日に最終トランシェが完了すれば、ソフトバンクのOpenAIへの累計投資額は646億ドルに達し、持ち分比率は約13%となる。 [e002:f04] ソフトバンクグループは、OpenAIへの投資の最終段階に充当するため、ドル建て・ユーロ建て社債で111億ドル（約1.8兆円）を調達した。 [e002:f05] 調達資金の大部分は、2月に合意した300億ドル（約4.8兆円）の追加投資のうち、最終となる100億ドル（約1.6兆円）のトランシェに充当される。 [e002:f06] ロイターが確認した条件提示書によると、同社は9月21日に販売を開始し、3.5年物は8.75%から8.875%、5.5年物は9.375%から9.5%、7.5年物は9.75%から9.875%の価格ガイダンスを示した。 [e002:f07] OpenAI以外にも、ソフトバンクはスターゲート関連のデータセンター、米国のAIインフラ、アーム・ホールディングス（NASDAQ:ARM）の拡大、ABBロボティクス（OTC:ABBNY）の買収計画など、一連のAI関連施策を進めている。 [e002:f08] 投資契約は2月にプレマネー評価額7,300億ドル（約115.8兆円）で締結され、ソフトバンク・ビジョン・ファンド2を通じて支払われる100億ドルずつの3回に均等分割された。 [e002:f09] 資金調達の構造と条件 今回の社債発行は、ソフトバンクが近年実施した社債発行の中でも最大級の規模となる。 [e002:f10] 社債発行と並行して、ソフトバンクは3月に締結した400億ドル（約6.3兆円）のブリッジローン契約のうち、残る100億ドルの借入枠を解消する計画も明らかにした。 [e002:f11] 2026年の最初の9カ月間だけで、ソフトバンクは146億ドル（約2.3兆円）のハイイールド債を発行しており、これはアジア太平洋・日本地域のハイイールド社債市場全体の63.4%に相当する。 [e002:f12] S&Pグローバル・レーティングスの吉村真紀子氏は、アームの堅調な株価がソフトバンクの信用力を支えており、OpenAIのIPO延期は信用力に直ちに悪影響を及ぼさないと記した。 [e002:f13] OpenAIは2026年に上場しないとサム・アルトマンCEOが今月述べ、データセンター開発子会社のSBエナジーも、早ければ9月と見込まれていた上場を延期した。 [e002:f14] より広範な資金調達の動き 今回の社債発行に先立ち、アポロ・グローバル・マネジメント（NYSE:APO）がソフトバンクのビジョン・ファンド2への融資を54億ドル（約8,600億円）から最大90億ドル（約1.4兆円）に増額する協議を行っていると報じられた。 [e002:f15] 日付 内容 規模 コスト 2026年3月 ブリッジローン契約締結 400億ドル 非公表 2026年9月 円建て個人向け社債、7年物 1兆円 4.75% 2026年9月 ドル建て・ユーロ建てシニア債 111億ドル 7.125% – 9.75% 注：通貨が異なるため利率の単純比較はできない。 [e002:f16] 同社はOpenAI単独で650億ドル（約10.3兆円）近くを投じる一方、データセンターを通じたインフラ層、アームを通じた半導体層、そして買収手続き中のABBロボティクスを通じたロボティクス層にも同時に投資している。

evidence.title: Jobber Launches MCP, Bringing Home and Commercial Service Data and Workflows Directly Into ChatGPT and Claude
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Through the Jobber Plugin in ChatGPT and Jobber Connector for Claude, service pros can ask questions about their business, identify what needs attention, and complete everyday administrative work—all with the context of their own Jobber account data. [e003:f02] When other supported services are connected to ChatGPT or Claude, Jobber can draw information from them directly, so nothing needs to be re-entered manually. [e003:f03] For example, a business owner could have a service inquiry in their email inbox, and the plugin in ChatGPT or connector for Claude can use that information to create a Client, Property, and Request in Jobber. [e003:f04] The lead now lives in Jobber with automations, follow-ups, and reporting attached, ready to move forward. evidence.title: OpenAI investigates growing list of incidents involving rogue AI agents
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The review could take months because of the scale of internal logs being examined. [e004:f02] OpenAI is investigating a growing number of incidents involving AI agents behaving in undesirable ways after the company disclosed that 53 images from ChatGPT users had been leaked. [e004:f03] Two people briefed on the matter told Reuters that the ChatGPT maker was still determining the full extent of unauthorised activity by its agents. [e004:f04] As of mid-September, OpenAI had identified about two dozen incidents involving agents behaving in undesirable ways, according to one person familiar with the matter. [e004:f05] The number has continued to rise as investigators uncover previously unknown cases. [e004:f06] OpenAI said the 53 leaked images were accessed by its agents through data used partly for model training. [e004:f07] Most have since been removed, while OpenAI is working with hosting providers to remove the remaining material. [e004:f08] Some ChatGPT consumer data can be used for model training unless users opt out, while enterprise data is not eligible for training. [e004:f09] OpenAI said training data is anonymised by removing metadata, names and other contact information. [e004:f10] However, people familiar with the company's practices told Reuters that anonymisation may not always completely eliminate personally identifiable information, creating a potential privacy risk. [e004:f11] OpenAI has notified dozens of third parties about improper activity. [e004:f12] It also said its models accessed information from websites operated by the US Securities and Exchange Commission and the US Census Bureau during research and training, but found no evidence of unauthorised access, compromised accounts or security breaches. [e004:f13] The disclosures follow several incidents involving OpenAI agents, including the company's revelation in July that its systems had breached AI repository Hugging Face. [e004:f14] More than 15 OpenAI-related incidents of varying severity have since been disclosed by the company, outside researchers or officials. [e004:f15] On September 16, OpenAI announced a framework for disclosing incidents involving misaligned AI agents, saying it would favour transparency even when the significance of an incident remained uncertain. [e004:f16] However, two people familiar with the investigation said the process had been tightly controlled and heavily shaped by lawyers.

SoftBank Invests $225M In Industrial Autonomous Vehicle Firm
evidence.body: [e002:f01] SoftBank Forms JV With Industrial Vehicle Automation Company September 25, 2026 | 3:18 pm ET Ciara Long, New York City A robotics company targeting the future of self-driving industrial vehicles has formed a new partnership to push its operations forward. [e002:f02] Unsplash/Shane McLendon Autonomous Solutions Inc. is forming a new joint venture with Tokyo-headquartered SoftBank Group Corp. to help the company develop and commercialize autonomous construction equipment for large infrastructure projects, according to a release . [e002:f03] ASI's equipment integrates an artificial intelligence -powered command and control platform with onboard computers to manage vehicle functions, sensors to spot and avoid obstacles, and communication technology including GPS, radio and cameras. [e002:f04] “This joint venture with SoftBank positions ASI at the forefront of autonomous construction innovation — built for scale, engineered for longevity, and open to every major equipment brand on the jobsite,” ASI CEO Mel Torrie said in a statement. [e002:f05] The firm is the latest in a string of construction tech companies to receive financial backing in recent years, with billions of dollars going into construction robotics and AI-powered tech each year, Construction Dive reported . [e002:f06] A series of firms have raised a total of $234M this summer alone, the outlet reported separately . [e002:f07] ASI isn’t the first construction tech company that SoftBank has thrown its weight behind. [e002:f08] The investment firm participated in a Series A funding round in August for Gravis Robotics that raised $200M. [e002:f09] Construction firms are also beginning to deploy the tech on sites. [e002:f10] In early September, construction and mining equipment company Caterpillar announced a partnership with Field AI to run automated machines across jobsites for tasks including inspections and risk identification. [e002:f11] That partnership followed two consecutive funding rounds where the firm raised a total of $405M, Construction Dive reported .

evidence.title: SoftBank Raises $11.1 Billion in Record High-Yield Bond Sale to Fund Final OpenAI Tranche
evidence.body: [e003:f01] SoftBank Group raised $11.1 billion in dollar- and euro-denominated bonds to fund the final $10 billion tranche of its $30 billion follow-on investment in OpenAI — the largest high-yield corporate bond sale on record, surpassing Numericable Group's $10.9 billion deal in 2014. [e003:f02] The offering priced $10 billion of dollar notes across three maturities at 8.625% to 9.75%, plus two €500 million euro tranches at 7.125% and 8%, after orders for the dollar portion topped $30 billion. [e003:f03] Shares rose as much as 7% in early Tokyo trading on September 24 before closing just 0.6% higher. [e003:f04] Once the tranche closes on October 1, SoftBank's cumulative OpenAI investment will reach $64.6 billion for roughly a 13% stake. [e003:f05] The company is retiring a $10 billion bridge facility, and its five-year credit default swap spread has widened past 400 basis points even as it funds $5.4 billion of robotics and $4 billion of data-center acquisitions.

This Tiny Car Launched Honda in America
evidence.body: [e001:f01] The Civic, the Accord, and all other Hondas flowed from the N600. [e001:f02] This 1971 model is for sale on Bring a Trailer. [e001:f03] Here’s an example of the first Honda to be officially sold in the ’s even smaller than a first-gen Honda Civic, with a two-cylinder engine and the footprint of an original one has a rebuilt engine and is ready to zip around through the 1960s, Honda grew in popularity as a well-recognized brand in the U.S. [e001:f04] It was such a byword for cheerful two-wheeled transportation that, back in 1964, the Beach Boys even released a song about how much fun riding a Honda was. [e001:f05] But across the Pacific, Soichiro Honda had big plans to go from two wheels to example of the first Honda car to hit the U.S. market, this bright yellow 1971 Honda N600 sedan just popped up on Bring a Trailer (which, like Car and Driver, is part of Hearst Autos). [e001:f06] Think of it as a proto-Civic, offering fuel-sipping transportation, a revvy two-cylinder engine that could keep up on the highway, and a surprising amount of interior space in a gnat-sized speaking, the N600 wasn’t the first four-wheeled Honda to arrive in North America, as there were a few S600 coupes and roadsters brought over privately into the U.S., and hundreds of them sold in Canada through motorcycle dealerships. [e001:f07] However, the N600 was the first official factory-supported effort, and it was something of a loyalty test for established Honda , if you were already selling Honda motorcycles and wanted to add the N600 to the mix, Honda required you to invest in a separate showroom. [e001:f08] Several dealers took the gamble, and when the Civic arrived later in the 1970s, they basically hit the the Civic established Honda as a major player in the U.S., the N600 was the beachhead effort. [e001:f09] It was a tiny little car, basically the size of an original Austin Mini, but thanks to the public’s familiarity with Honda’s motorcycles, it had a big was already selling the N360 in Japan under kei-car rules, but that car’s tiny two-cylinder engine would be no match for U.S. interstates. [e001:f10] So Honda stuffed a 600-cc parallel-twin engine into 50 prototype cars, then shipped them over the Pacific to see how they could handle everything from California heat to Midwest winters. [e001:f11] They worked, and for the 1970 model year, Honda started selling a production example is from 1971, and from its friendly face, you can just imagine Brian Wilson penning a song about cruising down the PCH at sunset in such a thing. [e001:f12] It’s finished in sunny Spring Yellow over a black vinyl interior, and it appears to be in tidy condition. [e001:f13] Hondas of this vintage wouldn’t have lasted long driving around Ohio, but this one hails from the warm climes of plucky two-cylinder engine was rated at 35 horsepower from the factory (Honda sometimes quotes 45 hp, but this was for the prototypes and Euro variants), which was plenty for a car that weighed about as much as two scooters. [e001:f14] This one benefits from a freshly rebuilt engine, and you also get a four-speed manual to stir things up a , so it’s not a SoCal hot rod, but it is an entirely enjoyable piece of Honda history, zippy, light, and full of joy. [e001:f15] The auction ends on September 30.

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e002:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e002:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e002:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e002:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e002:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e002:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e002:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e002:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e002:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e002:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: Franco Colapinto learns outcome of FIA investigation into three-car Baku clash
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Franco Colapinto has learned the outcome of the FIA's judgement on his role in the three-car collision at the restart of the Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix. [e001:f02] The Argentinian made an ambitious attempt to divebomb teammate Pierre Gasly after George Russell led away the restarted race after a Safety Car period at the Baku City Circuit . [e001:f03] But the Alpine's cold tyres and lack of realism in Colapinto's manoeuvre saw him career into the side of the sister Alpine, which in turn took out Lando Norris. [e001:f04] All three men retired as a result. [e001:f05] After the race, Colapinto offered a full and frank apology to both men, with Norris calling for him to receive a one-race ban for it. [e001:f06] Colapinto, who has shown much improvement across the season as a whole - resulting in a confirmed second season with the Enstone-based squad - admitted to media that he was expecting a penalty. [e001:f07] And after an investigation by stewards, a 10-second time penalty was the result, converted into a grid penalty given he retired from the race. [e001:f08] "The Stewards considered that COL was wholly or predominantly to blame for the collision," the stewards' document read. [e001:f09] "Although the incident occurred at the first corner following the restart, there was no contribution from another driver which would justify applying the first-lap / firstcorner more linient approach.

evidence.title: FIA stewards investigate Lewis Hamilton after F1 rival blasts Ferrari star
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Hamilton was competing in Thursday's second practice session at the Baku circuit when he got caught up in an incident with Racing Bull's Liam Lawson. [e003:f02] With around 20 minutes of the session left, Hamilton was going slowly coming out of the final corner heading into the long straight. [e003:f03] The 41-year-old appeared to be harvesting energy in his car to get optimal battery deployment, but unfortunately did so in front of Lawson. [e003:f04] Article continues under video As Lawson rapidly caught Hamilton, who was on the racing line, the New Zealander was forced to react quickly to avoid crashing into the back of the seven-time world champion. [e003:f05] On the radio to his team immediately after, Lawson fumed: "Oh my God that is so f***ing dangerous, oh my God dude, that is so f***ing dangerous." Hamilton spoke after the session appeared to send a warning to the stewards that penalising him would set a dangerous precedent for the rest of the weekend, saying: “I’m waiting to find out what they’re gonna say but I’ll tell you, we’re gonna have interesting discussions if there’s like a penalty from it cause, as I said, it’s Friday and it’s not changed anybody’s weekend. [e003:f06] If the incident happened during qualifying, Hamilton would have been staring at a grid penalty for blocking. [e003:f07] The stewards said: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 44 ( Lewis Hamilton ), the driver of Car 30 (Liam Lawson), team representatives and reviewed video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. [e003:f08] "The Race Director’s Competition Notes require cars on out laps or slow laps to remain on the extreme left from the exit of Turn 16 to the entry of Turn 18, and require Teams and Drivers to manage their gaps before Turn 18 so that they can travel from the apex of Turn 18 to the apex of Turn 19 without impeding a car on a competitive lap. [e003:f09] Lewis Hamilton escaped with a reprimand "Hamilton did not remain on the extreme left between Turns 16 and 18. [e003:f10] "Approaching Turn 19, while Lawson was closing from behind, Hamilton stayed on the racing line which required Lawson to lift and slightly brake. [e003:f11] "The Stewards therefore determined that Hamilton did not follow the traffic-management instructions and unnecessarily impeded Lawson. [e003:f12] "The Stewards also took into account the difficulty to manage the energy deployment from Turn 16 to Turn 19 and the end of the lap. [e003:f13] "Taking these circumstances into account, the Stewards impose a Driving Reprimand." Hamilton had bigger problems following practice, with Ferrari looking well off the pace of title rivals Mercedes in Baku. [e003:f14] The Ferrari star was only fifth fastest after Thursday practice, a couple of tenths down on team-mate Charles Leclerc but a huge 1.3 seconds down on his former Mercedes team-mate George Russell . [e003:f15] As an experienced motor sport reporter covering F1, MotoGP and the LeMans 24 Hour race, being part of GPFans has allowed me to work with a diverse team with all sorts of different backgrounds in watching the sport and given me a greater appreciation of F1. evidence.title: Cadillac signs former Red Bull and Aston Martin technical chiefs for F1 project
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Former Red Bull chief designer Craig Skinner and ex-Aston Martin aerodynamics director Eric Blandin headline three senior appointments intended to accelerate Cadillac’s F1 development News Summary Cadillac has appointed Craig Skinner, Eric Blandin and Tim Lean to senior technical positions Skinner spent approximately 20 years at Red Bull, while Blandin has worked for Red Bull, Ferrari, Mercedes and Aston Martin All three engineers will join before the end of 2026 as Cadillac strengthens its 2027 car programme Cadillac has announced three senior technical appointments as the Formula 1 newcomer continues to build its engineering structure and shifts increasing attention towards 2027. [e002:f02] Tim Lean will join as Chief Engineer – Aerodynamics Modelling and Simulation . [e002:f03] All three are expected to begin working for Cadillac before the end of 2026. [e002:f04] The team described the appointments as an important stage in its technical evolution, strengthening leadership across vehicle development and the wider aerodynamic department. [e002:f05] “Today marks another step forward for Cadillac Formula 1 Team, as we announce three senior technical appointments who will join us before the end of 2026,” Cadillac said. [e002:f06] “With championship-winning experience across vehicle development, aerodynamics and modelling, they will add valuable expertise as we continue to grow our technical team.” Skinner brings two decades of Red Bull experience Skinner represents one of Cadillac’s most significant technical recruits since entering Formula 1. [e002:f07] The British engineer joined Red Bull in 2006 as a computational fluid dynamics engineer and progressed through several senior positions within its aerodynamic structure. [e002:f08] The appointment also follows Cadillac’s unsuccessful attempt to recruit Red Bull chief engineer Paul Monaghan. [e002:f09] He worked at Jaguar and remained with the operation following its transformation into Red Bull, before moving to Ferrari in 2010. [e002:f10] The French engineer joined Mercedes one year later and eventually became chief aerodynamicist during the team’s championship-winning period. [e002:f11] He left for Aston Martin in 2022, initially working as deputy technical director before assuming responsibility as aerodynamics director. [e002:f12] Blandin departed Aston Martin in 2026 following the technical restructuring led by Adrian Newey and Enrico Cardile. [e002:f13] His recruitment gives Cadillac direct knowledge of the aerodynamic methods used by Red Bull, Ferrari, Mercedes and Aston Martin , although the team must still integrate that experience into its own developing infrastructure. [e002:f14] Cadillac builds around 2027 programme The appointments come after a wider leadership restructuring. [e002:f15] Skinner, Blandin and Lean will all join before the end of the year, allowing their influence to begin during the development of Cadillac’s second Formula 1 car. [e002:f16] Cadillac has appointed Craig Skinner as Chief Development Engineer, Eric Blandin as Head of Aerodynamics and Tim Lean as Chief Engineer for Aerodynamics Modelling and Simulation.

evidence.title: Cadillac F1 Signs Tech Trio Skinner, Blandin and Lean
evidence.body: [e004:f01] These Cadillac F1 technical hires mark the team’s biggest recruitment move yet as it builds a competitive technical department almost from scratch. [e004:f02] Skinner joins from Red Bull, where he worked as chief designer, while Blandin arrives after a spell as Aston Martin’s deputy technical director. [e004:f03] Lean completes the trio, moving into a senior aerodynamics role. [e004:f04] All three will slot into Cadillac’s growing technical hierarchy as the team prepares for its first campaign. [e004:f05] Official Details and Primary Source Confirmations Skinner takes up the role of chief development engineer, according to reporting . [e004:f06] Blandin has been appointed head of aerodynamics, and Lean joins as Chief Engineer, Aerodynamics Modelling and Simulation. [e004:f07] Lean will report directly to Blandin within that group. [e004:f08] Cadillac confirmed the timing of the arrivals in an official statement, saying the trio will “all join the team in the next few months.” That wording leaves room for staggered start dates, but it commits the team to having its new technical leadership in place well before the season begins. [e004:f09] Autosport confirmation of the appointments matches the detail set out by Cadillac. [e004:f10] Impact on Engineering Squad and Aerodynamic Structure The signings give Cadillac a clear command structure for its aerodynamics department, an area every new entrant has to build up almost from zero. [e004:f11] Blandin’s experience at Aston Martin, where he worked closely on car concept and development, should shape how Cadillac approaches its early aero programme. [e004:f12] Skinner’s move from Red Bull brings design know-how from the team that has dominated much of the current regulation era. [e004:f13] His title of chief development engineer suggests he will oversee how Cadillac turns concepts into a race-ready car, working alongside the aerodynamics group led by Blandin and Lean. [e004:f14] Cadillac Management Restructure and Upcoming Timeline The new arrivals follow a wider shake-up at the top of Cadillac’s organisation. [e004:f15] Skinner, Blandin and Lean are all expected to join Cadillac in the coming months, per the team’s own statement, rather than in one single wave. evidence.title: アロンソ、2026年F1マシンに不満「20年かけて学んだ走り方を見直す必要」FIA会長と改善策を協議
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 改善策については、FIAのモハメド・ベン・スレイエム会長とも直接話し合っているという。 [e005:f02] 一方、2027年の去就については、アストンマーティンF1が本人の決断を待っている。 [e005:f03] ■アロンソ「20年かけて学んだ走り方を見直さなければならない」
